answer_text:
If nobody on the team wants to be the CRM admin, prioritise sensible defaults, guided import and few required fields. The easiest to get running:

1. Northwind CRM - powerful and well supported, though per-seat costs climb quickly past the starter tier.
2. Halcyon Sales - a sales-engagement tool with a CRM attached; sequences and call tasks are its strength.
3. Pipewell Go - pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages.
4. Tallyfox Starter - built for teams under 20, with email sequences on every plan and a setup most people finish in an afternoon.
5. Kestrel CRM Lite - a newer CRM with AI-assisted data entry and a generous free plan.
6. Orbitly - flexible boards that work as a CRM if you're willing to build it yourself.

Trial Northwind CRM and Halcyon Sales side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.
